findings.symptom: The intended uppercase technique banner renders its embedded $1\times1$ as literal dollar signs and TeX source in the local HTML and screenshot.
findings.suggested_repair: Render the embedded one-by-one size as math or use plain typographic text such as “1×1”.

findings.excerpt: title: "A short floating-point dot product obeys the gamma_n error bound"
findings.symptom: The title displays gamma_n with a literal underscore rather than a rendered subscript.
findings.suggested_repair: Use a rendered gamma subscript or readable wording such as “gamma n”.

findings.excerpt: title: "The singular values of a linear map as the eigenvalues of the positive square root of T^*T"
findings.symptom: The title displays T^*T with a literal caret and asterisk instead of a rendered adjoint product.
findings.suggested_repair: Wrap T^*T in math delimiters or use a readable typographic form.

findings.excerpt: title: "Singular values are well defined because the positive square root of T^*T is unique"
findings.symptom: The title displays T^*T with a literal caret and asterisk instead of a rendered adjoint product.
findings.suggested_repair: Wrap T^*T in math delimiters or use a readable typographic form.

diagram_candidates.rationale: A compact recurrence diagram could make the projection, residual, normalization, and breakdown condition easier to follow at a glance; the complete definition is already stated in text.
diagram_candidates.draw_or_check: Show orthonormal basis vectors v_1,…,v_j; route Av_j to projections h_ij=⟨Av_j,v_i⟩ onto each v_i and residual w_j=Av_j−Σ_i h_ij v_i; label h_{j+1,j}=||w_j|| and, when nonzero, v_{j+1}=w_j/h_{j+1,j}; mark w_j=0 as exact breakdown. It should depict the relations without serving as a proof.
